title: Hearty Smoky German Anchovy Fillet Puff Pastry
description: A smoky and nostalgic German dish featuring anchovy fillet in a flaky puff pastry, perfect for a satisfying snack or light meal, and made halal-friendly by using vegetarian alternatives to traditional ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a small bowl, mix together the smoked paprika, olive oil, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Arrange the anchovy fillets on one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water, then spoon the smoked paprika mixture over the anchovy fillets.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Use a knife to cut a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
Place the pastry on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
